generatedProse.practice-connection:
Everything in this course applies to the work you are already doing. In almost every subject, writing is how most of your learning is judged, from essays and reports to exams. Every one of those tasks draws on the same process: understand the task, plan, draft, and revise. Treat what follows as being about your own assignments, not about writing in the abstract, and the process will carry into every module you take.

The same cycle runs well beyond your studies. In professional life you are given a brief, your work is judged against a standard, and you improve it before it is seen. Writing clearly and to a deadline is a habit you keep long after you graduate.
